description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Player icon style:** the always repeat overlay button now follows `Player icon style` (Fluent, Phosphor, Phosphor Light, Phosphor Fill, Phosphor Duotone, Ionicons, Sharp and Custom). The selected state keeps its highlight color. Automatic, Thin and Bold keep the original icon.
- **Player icon style:** the `Minimal bar` and `Minimal bar 2` miniplayer types now use the chosen style for the play, pause and close buttons, and the miniplayer play, pause, replay and close icons are replaced wherever the app sets them.
- **Player icon style:** the Picture-in-picture button has its own Ionicons icon instead of the default bold one.
- **Player icon style:** custom icon packs made for Morphe now work for the Reload video, video scale (fit, stretch, zoom), speed, mute and download buttons. A file with the fork's own name wins when both are in the pack.
- **Visual preferences icons:** `Notification media controls`, `Download options` and both Voice over translation provider screens now have an icon.
- **Feed flyout:** the `Add to RVX queue`, Picture-in-picture and similar flyout rows added by RVX use the bold icon of the app's own rows on YouTube 21.12 and later, so they match even when `Disable bold icons` is on.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.18.0...v1.18.1)
